description: 粕屋町 公共施設一覧(データ連携基盤) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 粕屋町. 福岡都市圏各自治体でフォーマットを共通化した、粕屋町の公共施設一覧データです。. Coverage: 粕屋町. The portal files it under the publisher 粕屋町. Its tags are 位置情報, 公共施設, 共通フォーマット, 推奨データセット, 緯度経度. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2025-10-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
